run_stats: run the solana_client stats command to get network slot, epoch, TPS, supply, and SOL price
run_wallet_balance: run the solana_client wallet command to query a Solana address balance and SPL token holdings with USD values
run_tx_details: run the solana_client tx command to fetch transaction details by signature including balance changes
run_token_info: run the solana_client token command to retrieve SPL token metadata, supply, price, and top holders
run_activity: run the solana_client activity command to list recent transaction signatures for a Solana address
run_nft_portfolio: run the solana_client nft command to list NFTs owned by a Solana wallet address
run_whale_scan: run the solana_client whales command to scan the latest block for large SOL transfers
run_price_lookup: run the solana_client price command to look up token price by mint address or known symbol
